1.overview:
Ted Ligety: The Average Olympian

One of Ted Ligety’s coaches remembers an average kid who “wasn’t that fast.” A childhood friend remembers moments of brilliance. Neither could see the skier who would eventually win Olympic gold and redefine giant slalom.

The Unexpected Champion returns Ligety to the people, places, pressures, failures and changes that shaped him before the ending made his story look inevitable.

Not to ask why nobody saw the champion sooner.

To ask how the champion became possible.

overview:
We know what champions did. We rarely know what made it possible.  The Unexpected Champion returns extraordinary people to the conditions that shaped them; the people, places, pressures, failures and choices that disappeared once the ending became known. We bring those conditions back into the room and ask a different question:

How did this person become possible?

This isn’t a career retrospective. It’s a return.
title: The Unexpected Champion
